article_stem: 261125.AutoGen.NIST, 반도체 계측 AI의 검출 한계 검증 추진

image_review.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Editorial image for a Korean article on semiconductor scanning electron microscope metrology and checking AI detection limits before fab deployment. One original generic industrial scene, not any real company's or NIST's equipment. Widescreen 16:9. Restrained realistic photograph of the front of a closed semiconductor inspection instrument: an extremely simple smooth off-white cabinet with one small circular dark wafer-loading port and a brushed-metal handle, a narrow part of a cleanroom service corridor softly blurred at the far edge. No people, no screens, no diagram, no actual SEM micrograph, no visible chip pattern, no text or numbers, no logos, no brand or distinctive commercial product design, no watermark. Eye-level composition, large smooth pale surfaces, soft low-contrast diffuse light, subtle shadows, very low fine-detail and very low visual clutter, credible calm factory inspection environment. The round load port is the single focal subject, occupying approximately one fifth of the image; the rest is smooth softly graded clean equipment surface. Leave bottom-right area empty for a small Korean AI disclosure added later. This is an illustrative generic scene, never evidence of research results or deployment.
